failures.assertion: Reports the `git apply --cached --check` failure (`error: corrupt patch at line 9`) and asks the user, since the hunks cannot be separated safely.
failures.evidence: It reports "Likely causes of `corrupt patch at line 9`" but asks the user only in the shared-hunk case ("Only one `@@` line: ... Stop and ask you"); otherwise it proceeds to "rebuild `pick.diff` from `all.diff`" without asking.
